about: The closure runner's own child reaper preserves the helper's status, reaps other ended children, and does not wait on running children. The focused killer observes child-exit events before checking ended-child reaping.

mutants.name: b15-r8-closure-skips-ended-child
mutants.rule: An ended non-helper child is reaped, not left as a zombie.

mutants.name: b15-r8-closure-steals-helper-status
mutants.rule: The helper's exec.Cmd remains the sole wait owner of its exit status.

mutants.name: rm-cgo-link-input
mutants.from: {"-lc", file, "GNU ld's cwd lookup while the Go toolchain links a cgo dependency"},
mutants.rule: A real cgo linker cwd input belongs to the toolchain inputs; observation and cache hashing must remain enabled.

mutants.name: g16fix2-alone-shares-a-run
mutants.rule: The code is in a test file, which the cover tool does not instrument. A test of runsAlone (it runs its package again) holds a sweep run of its own.

mutants.name: g16fix2-alone-runs-twice
mutants.rule: The code is in a test file, which the cover tool does not instrument. The last run of the other tests skips the tests run alone, so each test runs once.

mutants.name: g16fix2-sweep-ignores-alone
mutants.from: return planPackage(names, costs, sweepRunBudget, runsAlone[dir]), nil
mutants.rule: The code is in a test file, which the cover tool does not instrument. The sweep's plan gives each runsAlone test (cmd/ergo's TestPackageNeverWritesUnderHome) a run of its own.

mutants.name: g16fix2-stale-alone-accepted
mutants.rule: The code is in a test file, which the cover tool does not instrument. A runsAlone name that is not a test of its package fails the sweep.
